prompt:
Hand-painted 2D game art in the style of a 1999 storybook RPG.
Soft watercolour and gouache shading with visible brush texture and 3 to 5 value steps per colour.
Warm golden key light from the upper left, blue-violet shadows.
Selective coloured outlines, rounded organic shapes, whimsical fairy-tale mood. Softened saturation.
No writing anywhere: labels, signs and covers are blank or carry simple symbols.
The first image is a layout sketch: a dark door arch on a magenta background. Paint finished, richly detailed game art over it:
the front door of the building is exactly where the dark arch is, at the middle of the bottom edge,
the same size as the arch. Paint the whole building around that door, filling the frame from side to side and top to bottom, with its natural outline.
with a few short steps or a threshold leading down from the door to the bottom edge. Nothing else stands in front of the door.
The other images show the approved art style and, where it is the same place, how it looked before: keep its character.
Biome: Mirage Desert; its light and mood.
Subject: Sultana Zahra's Palace, the whole building seen from outside, three-quarter top-down view. a magnificent desert palace of sandstone and white plaster: a tall pointed arch doorway with carved wooden doors at the bottom middle, golden onion domes and slender minarets, blue and turquoise mosaic tiles around the arches, silk awnings in deep red and saffron, palm trees and a reflecting pool before the doors.
Background: one flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) filling everything behind the building, with no ground, scenery, gradient, glow or shadow on it. No magenta anywhere in the building. Lanterns and windows have no glow or halo spilling onto the background.
Avoid: photorealistic, 3D render, anime cel shading, vector art, flat design, thick black outlines, pure black, pure white, harsh contrast, neon, lens flare, blur, noise, text, letters, words, labels with writing, watermark, signature, frame, border, vignette, background scenery, cast shadow on the background.
